ja394:1.1: Paṇītaṃ bhuñjase bhattaṃ sappitelañ ca mātula, atha kena nu vaṇṇena kiso tvam asi vāyasā 'ti.
ja394:2.1: Amittamajjhe vasato tesu āmisam esato niccaṃ ubbiggahadayassa kuto kākassa daḷhiyaṃ.
ja394:3.1: Niccaṃ ubbegino kākā vaṃkā pāpena kammunā, laddho piṇḍo na pīṇeti, kiso ten' asmi vaṭṭaka.
ja394:4.1: Lūkhāni tiṇabījāni appasinehāni bhuñjasi, atha kena nu vaṇṇena thūlo tvam asi vaṭṭakā 'ti.
ja394:5.1: Appicchā appacintāya avidūragamanena ca laddhāladdhena yāpento thūlo ten' asmi vāyasa.
ja394:6.1: Appicchassa hi posassa appacintisukhassa ca susaṃgahitapamāṇassa vuttī susamudānayā ti
